about: The hooks protocol (docs/relay-hooks.md, The agent-side state machine): one case per row of the table, and the failure cases. Each step runs one hook (claude: plugin/hooks/hook.py, codex: codex/hook.py) against a scripted fake Seeker that records the calls. answers maps a route (claims, check, done, handoffs, artifacts) to answers used in order (the last repeats); an answer is {status?, body?, sleep?}. A string "{now+N}" becomes now plus N seconds in µs. expect: calls (the claims, check, done and handoffs calls in order, each [method, route, a subset of its body]), context_has and context_not (the injected text or deny reason), decision (deny or none), state (a subset of the state file after; tasks and holds compared by their keys). Synthetic: built by hand from the Seeker routes in docs/relay.md, not recorded.
